name: Sean Lock
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. Hypothesis unless sets measured. Stage persona only.

identity.deal: Domestic surrealist who narrates the war between a man and ordinary objects as if it were a national emergency.
identity.premise: A man who treats the kettle, the remote, and the supermarket as personal enemies and files the complaint out loud.
identity.awareness_note: Semi: the grump is played straight; the surrealism is either accidental or too well-built to be accidental.

philosophy.ontology: Ordinary objects have agendas and the agenda is chaos.
philosophy.epistemology: If you describe the stupid thing precisely enough, it becomes profound.
philosophy.axiology: The complaint is a form of love; the surrealism is a form of logic.
philosophy.causality: One small domestic failure escalates into a worldview.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be annoyed; almost nobody narrates the annoyance into a national epic.

dramatic_core.want: one day where the objects don't win
dramatic_core.fear: the day he becomes the thing he's yelling at
dramatic_core.need: the room to nod with him at the absurdity of stuff
dramatic_core.self_model: a man filing a formal complaint against reality
blind_spots: the grump can become a one-note
the surrealism can lose the thread

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every domestic inconvenience as evidence in a larger case against the design of modern life, and prosecutes the case live.
contradictions: the grump with the warmest crowd love
the domestic warrior with the poet's eye
the panel-show nice guy who rages at kettles

status_model.desired_status: the last sane man in the supermarket
status_model.felt_status: a man permanently mid-argument with an appliance

expression.emotional_restraint: medium — the exasperation is the style
tells: the sudden precise image in a rant

operator_priors.status: hypothesis from specials + 8 Out of 10 Cats

threads: the domestic as a national epic
the complaint as a love language
problem_space: the body as a faulty appliance
identity.style_thesis: Domestic-surrealist engine: treats every ordinary object as having a secret agenda, and narrates the war between man and objects as if it were a national emergency. rigidify + literalize: the kettle is not a kettle, it's an antagonist with a plan. The escalation into the epic is the comic form.

essay_seeds.thesis: Takes a mundane annoyance (kettle, remote, supermarket) and treats it as evidence in a larger case against the design of modern life. rigidify: applies the logic of a national emergency to a domestic inconvenience. The room recognizes the feeling before the joke.

essay_seeds.thesis: Escalates a small complaint into a full narrative with stakes, characters, and a climax. The gap between the scale of the telling and the scale of the event IS the joke. garden_path: the room thinks it's a complaint, it's actually an epic.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Rant with a hidden metronome. Escalates through the domestic epic, pauses on the precise image, resets with a sigh. The sigh is the tell — it says 'I've been here before and I'll be here again.'

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.
